CoercPressWatch0.description: Black/Subjugation. 07-24r (H8 `focus-change`): the talent is an OBSERVER — it reacts to a focus loss it did not cause, which no rule could see before the watch kinds were widened. Every gate the hand-rolled focus-watcher loop applied is here as data: `disposition: enemy` is Ben's 07-12 ruling (an ALLY spending focus must not hand you the debuff — the card says 'an enemy' for that reason), `rangeColor: black` is the Attunement Range, and `once: round-per-target` is the printed once-per-round-per-character limit. `payloadTarget: actor` because a focus change has only one party: the creature that spent.

CoercPressMod000.description: Black/Subjugation. The payload, and what the bespoke `cogDisadv` flag became: `attr: "int, wil"` IS a Cognitive test, and nextTestMod has carried that gate since the Blue/Red Attunement keys (07-03c). `target: victim` binds it to the creature that lost the focus rather than re-reading your current targets — a passive watcher has none.

PredInsZeroWatc0.description: Black/Subjugation. 07-24r (H8 `focus-change`): 'when any character reaches 0 focus' is `whenTotal: at-most 0` — no range gate and no disposition gate, because the talent has none. `chain: true` is load-bearing and this is the only rule in the project that sets it: the 07-05 test pass found that a creature emptied BY Whispered Doubt's extra loss never triggered the regain, and a watcher-caused event is suppressed by default.

PredInsZeroGain0.description: Black/Subjugation. The regain, via H10 `edha-focus`. `target: self` — the focus goes to the OWNER, not to the creature that ran dry.
